opws_definition: Oracle Patch Within Scope: start from the frozen parent-commit state, apply only the known reference NON-TEST patch content for files permitted by the selector's selected scope, leave reference-changed files outside the scope at the parent state, run the frozen behavior contract, run the frozen preservation contract, classify.
perfect_generator_question: Assuming a perfect generator that could reproduce the known reference change for files selected by this scope, is the selected scope behaviorally sufficient under the frozen test contract?

interpretation_boundary.opws_pass_means: the selected scope was sufficient for the observed frozen behavior + preservation contract when the known reference patch was used inside that scope (perfect-generator assumption).
opws_pass_does_not_mean: the selector identified every historically changed file
the selector is a complete causal oracle
functional correctness of generated code has been demonstrated
interpretation_boundary.required_wording: behavioral sufficiency under the reference-patch / perfect-generator assumption

clean_state_requirement.start: frozen PARENT commit state (exact historical pre-change repository state)
clean_state_requirement.materialization: inside LINUX from git objects ONLY; Windows/NTFS-materialized trees are INVALID for OPWS execution
clean_state_requirement.interpretation_note: The mission phrase 'exact historical target repository state' is interpreted with the frozen precedent (scoped_gold_diff = git diff <parent> <target> -- <selected>, applied onto the parent worktree): post-change reference content is defined by the frozen target-commit git objects; the OPWS worktree is parent state plus only the scoped reference patch content.

patch_application_semantics.convention: git diff <parent> <target> -- <selected files>, per selected non-test path, deterministic
patch_application_semantics.reference_source: frozen gold proxies (observed changed non-test paths) + frozen parent/target git objects

status_semantics.MODIFIED: hunk applied onto parent file; selectable by parent-commit selectors
status_semantics.DELETED: deletion hunk applied; file absent after OPWS patch; selectable by parent-commit selectors
status_semantics.RENAMED: old path selectable at parent (deletion side); new path NOT parent-visible (addition side; reference-derived arms only)
status_semantics.ADDED: NOT selectable by any parent-commit selector; reference-derived arms (GOLD/SELECT_ALL) may include it as full-file creation from target-commit blob

patch_application_semantics.added_file_rule: a parent-commit-selector scope never contains a newly ADDED file; if a frozen prediction lists a path absent at parent it is NOT silently dropped - counted as invalid_prediction_path_count and excluded with reason per task/arm
patch_application_semantics.primary_treatment: scoped reference patch including ADDED/RENAMED-new-path reference files for reference-derived arms, as defined above
patch_application_semantics.sensitivity_analysis: secondary treatment in which reference ADDED and RENAMED-new-path files are excluded from EVERY scope; both primary and sensitivity results reported; any disagreement is reported as a sensitivity-limit note
patch_application_semantics.reference_test_changes: test-file changes are NOT part of any selector scope; they belong to the COMMON behavior contract applied IDENTICALLY across all arms for a given task
patch_application_semantics.owner_correction_ref: OWNER-CORRECTION #2 (M/A/D/R semantics frozen before outcomes; primary + sensitivity)

behavior_contract.f2p_node_set_source: frozen evaluator artifacts (BEHAVIORAL_F2P, SYMBOL_ABSENCE_F2P), bounded by frozen per-task count, selector-blind
behavior_contract.execution: frozen evaluator + E1 on the OPWS-patched worktree; per-node status recording; non-passing F2P node blocks resolution (fail-closed)
behavior_contract.behavior_sufficient: 1 iff every required frozen F2P node is present and passes (strict semantics)

preservation_contract.p2p_u: frozen unchanged-test STABLE_P2P identities (outcome-blind cap-200, STABLE over 3 reps)
preservation_contract.preservation_pass: 1 iff every frozen stable-pass preservation identity still passes on the OPWS worktree

metrics.historical_recall: |scope intersect gold non-test files| / |gold non-test files|
metrics.recall_gap: historical_recall < 1 AND opws_joint_pass; interpretation LIMITED to 'some historically changed non-test file was not required under the frozen observed behavior + preservation contract'; NOT selector completeness evidence; NOT a failure

statistical_summary.primary_inference: paired effect estimates + 95% CI on the paired eligible population
statistical_summary.ni_margin: NONE. No non-inferiority/equivalence margin is chosen in this freeze; no margin may be introduced post-hoc to compensate for small n; any future margin requires independent pre-outcome justification in DECISIONS.md
statistical_summary.primary_object: sufficiency-scope frontier (joint/behavioral sufficiency vs scope size)
statistical_summary.rq6: DESIGN_ONLY and deferred to a separate future amendment; NOT executed in this mission; does not gate RQ3

binding_boundary.binding_requires: Full-D7 scope/census issue resolved AND a valid population hash frozen
binding_boundary.binding_may_only: write the population-binding schema; SHALL NOT alter protocol semantics
